name: simple_research_chain
description: A 3-step chain: research a topic, analyze findings, write a summary

nodes.description: Search the web for information on the given topic

config.system_prompt: You are an analytical research assistant. Analyze the provided research findings and extract key facts, themes, patterns, credibility assessment, and gaps. Output structured bullet points.

nodes.description: Analyze the research findings for key insights

config.system_prompt: You are a professional summarizer. Create a clear, concise summary accessible to a general audience.

nodes.description: Create a final summary of the analyzed research

input_schema.topic: string - The research topic to investigate
